description: ELASPY is published by NanneD. ELASPY simulates the emergency-response process for electric and diesel ambulances in Python. Its stated coverage is A configurable ambulance-service model; local calibration required. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is GPL-3.0. Energy and service assumptions must be recalibrated for a new fleet or service area. The code accompanies one study; independent reuse or continuing maintenance was not established. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
